title: F.A.A. Declares a Rare Nationwide Ground Stop

title: Jensen Huang’s Resignation From Nvidia Worries the A.I. Start-Up World

title: Why Jensen Huang Was Essential to Nvidia’s Rise
partialText: Jensen Huang was the driving force at Nvidia, with 60 direct reports and no clear succession plan. Tripp Mickle, one of our technology reporters, examines Mr. Huang’s central role in the company and the artificial intelligence industry.

partialText: The ousted Nvidia chief executive was the consummate dealmaker leading the trillion-dollar A.I. build out.

title: Trump Signals New Strategy on Iran: A Waiting Game

title: Book Review: ‘Promise Me, America,’ by Joe Biden

title: Lauren Boebert Loses Re-election Bid in Colorado House Race to Eileen Laubacher

title: Hakeem Jeffries Pushes to Lock Down House Speakership, With No Challenger Emerging

title: Why New England’s Republican Governors Withstood the Blue Wave

title: Cargo Ship Crashes Into Docked Riverboat in New Orleans

title: Sister June Carpenter, the Oldest Shaker, Has Died
